"""Exporte les données de l'appli GAP pour les 3 indices (S&P 500, CAC 40, MSCI World)."""
import json, math, os, sys
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
sys.path.insert(0, HERE)
import backtest_v3 as us
import backtest_v4_indices as mi

OUT = os.path.join(HERE, "..", "site", "data"); os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
CODE = [{"label": n, "value": open(os.path.join(HERE, n)).read(), "type": "code", "lang": "python"}
        for n in ["export_site.py", "backtest_v3.py", "backtest_v4_indices.py"]]
META = CODE + [{"label": "Données", "value": (
    "FRED (US : BAA10Y, UNRATE, FEDFUNDS, PCEPILFE, DTWEXBGS/TWEXBMTH, USEPUINDXM, USALOLITOAASTSAM, TB3MS ; "
    "zone euro : DEULOLITOAASTSAM, FRALOLITOAASTSAM, LRHUTTTTFRM156S, LRHUTTTTDEM156S, CP0000EZ19M086NEST, ECBDFR, "
    "IRSTCI01EZM156N, IRLTLT01DEM156N, DEXUSEU, CCUSMA02EZM618N, EUEPUINDXM ; Chine : CHNLOLITOAASTSAM), "
    "MSCI (MSCI World prix et dividendes réinvestis, USD), Yahoo Finance (CAC 40), multpl.com (bénéfices S&P 500), "
    "Shiller, VIX CBOE, Brent EIA. Mise à jour automatique chaque mois.")}]
LAST = us.FIN; PREV = LAST - pd.DateOffset(months=3)

def clean(v):
    if isinstance(v, (float, np.floating)): return None if not math.isfinite(v) else round(float(v), 4)
    return v
def dump(name, rows):
    rows = [{k: clean(v) for k, v in r.items()} for r in rows]
    json.dump({"rows": rows, "meta": META}, open(f"{OUT}/{name}.json", "w"), ensure_ascii=False); print(name, len(rows))
zname = lambda p: None if not np.isfinite(p) else ("prudence" if p <= .2 else "favorable" if p > .8 else "neutre")

# séries par indice : (indice D, percentile, prix, piliers)
pct_sp = us.pct_rank(us.idx_v2c)
SER = {"S&P 500": dict(D=us.idx_v2c, pct=pct_sp, prix=us.price,
                       P=us.P.rename(columns={"infl_v2": "infl"})[["croissance", "infl", "financier", "valo", "sentiment", "incertitude"]]),
       "CAC 40": dict(D=mi.OUT["CAC 40"]["D"], pct=mi.OUT["CAC 40"]["pct"], prix=mi.OUT["CAC 40"]["prix"], P=mi.OUT["CAC 40"]["P"]),
       "MSCI World": dict(D=mi.OUT["MSCI World"]["D"], pct=mi.OUT["MSCI World"]["pct"], prix=mi.OUT["MSCI World"]["prix"],
                          P=mi.OUT["MSCI World"]["P"])}

# 1. historique
h = []
for nom, s in SER.items():
    for d in s["D"].loc["1996-01-01":LAST].dropna().index:
        p = s["pct"][d]
        h.append({"indice_nom": nom, "mois": d.strftime("%Y-%m"), "indice": s["D"][d],
                  "percentile": p * 100 if np.isfinite(p) else None, "zone": zname(p), "prix": s["prix"][d]})
dump("historique", h)

# 2. piliers
DESC = {
    "S&P 500": {"croissance": "Indicateur avancé OCDE US, chômage US", "infl": "Core PCE vs 2 %, hausse des Fed funds",
                "financier": "Écart de crédit Baa, dollar large, Brent", "valo": "Rendement des bénéfices − taux 10 ans (garde-fou, hors score)",
                "sentiment": "VIX, momentum du S&P 500", "incertitude": "Incertitude politique US (EPU)"},
    "CAC 40": {"croissance": "Indicateurs avancés OCDE (Allemagne/France 65 %, US 20 %, Chine 15 %), chômage",
               "infl": "Inflation zone euro et taux BCE (65 %), Core PCE et Fed (20 %)",
               "financier": "Écart de crédit Baa, Brent, euro (un euro faible aide le CAC 40)",
               "valo": "Non disponible (pas d'historique gratuit du PER du CAC 40)",
               "sentiment": "VIX (VSTOXX indisponible), momentum du CAC 40", "incertitude": "EPU Europe (65 %) et US (20 %)"},
    "MSCI World": {"croissance": "Indicateurs avancés OCDE (US 70 %, Allemagne/France 20 %, Chine 10 %), chômage",
                   "infl": "Core PCE et Fed (70 %), inflation zone euro et BCE (20 %)",
                   "financier": "Écart de crédit Baa, dollar large, Brent",
                   "valo": "Non disponible (pas d'historique gratuit du PER du MSCI World)",
                   "sentiment": "VIX, momentum du MSCI World", "incertitude": "EPU US (70 %) et Europe (20 %)"}}
NOMS = [("croissance", "Croissance", 25), ("infl", "Inflation et banques centrales", 15), ("financier", "Conditions financières", 20),
        ("valo", "Valorisation", 15), ("sentiment", "Sentiment et tendance", 15), ("incertitude", "Géopolitique et incertitude", 10)]
rows = []
for nom, s in SER.items():
    P = s["P"]
    for col, lib, poids in NOMS:
        sc = P[col][LAST] if col in P else np.nan; sp = P[col][PREV] if col in P else np.nan
        rows.append({"indice_nom": nom, "pilier": lib, "poids": poids, "score": sc, "score_3m": sp,
                     "variation_3m": sc - sp if np.isfinite(sc) and np.isfinite(sp) else None,
                     "dans_le_score": "non (garde-fou)" if col == "valo" and np.isfinite(sc) else ("non (indisponible)" if not np.isfinite(sc) else "oui"),
                     "indicateurs": DESC[nom][col]})
rows_piliers = rows
dump("piliers", rows)

# 3. indicateurs (dernière valeur), toutes zones
LIB = [("g_us_cli", "Indicateur avancé OCDE US, variation 3 mois", "États-Unis", "pt", 1),
       ("g_us_chom", "Chômage US, variation 6 mois", "États-Unis", "pt", -1),
       ("g_ez_cli", "Indicateur avancé OCDE Allemagne/France, variation 3 mois", "Zone euro", "pt", 1),
       ("g_ez_chom", "Chômage Allemagne/France, variation 6 mois", "Zone euro", "pt", -1),
       ("g_cn_cli", "Indicateur avancé OCDE Chine, variation 3 mois", "Chine", "pt", 1),
       ("i_us_pce", "Écart du Core PCE à 2 %", "États-Unis", "pt", -1),
       ("i_us_taux", "Hausse des Fed funds sur 6 mois", "États-Unis", "pt", -1),
       ("i_ez_hicp", "Écart de l'inflation zone euro à 2 %", "Zone euro", "pt", -1),
       ("i_ez_taux", "Hausse du taux BCE sur 6 mois", "Zone euro", "pt", -1),
       ("f_credit", "Écart de crédit Baa − 10 ans", "Monde", "pt", -1),
       ("f_usd", "Dollar large, variation 6 mois", "Monde", "%", -100),
       ("f_eur_faible", "Euro/dollar, variation 6 mois", "Zone euro", "%", -100),
       ("f_oil", "Brent, variation 6 mois", "Monde", "%", -100),
       ("s_vix", "VIX (moyenne du mois)", "Monde", "pts", -1),
       ("s_mom_cac", "Momentum CAC 40 (12-1 mois)", "Zone euro", "%", 100),
       ("s_mom_msci", "Momentum MSCI World (12-1 mois)", "Monde", "%", 100),
       ("u_us_epu", "Incertitude politique US (EPU)", "États-Unis", "pts", -1),
       ("u_ez_epu", "Incertitude politique Europe (EPU)", "Zone euro", "pts", -1)]
rows = [{"indicateur": "Momentum S&P 500 (12-1 mois)", "zone_geo": "États-Unis", "valeur": us.ind["s_mom"][LAST] * 100, "unite": "%",
         "score_z": us.Z["s_mom"][LAST], "mois": LAST.strftime("%Y-%m")},
        {"indicateur": "Prime de risque S&P 500 (bénéfices − 10 ans)", "zone_geo": "États-Unis", "valeur": us.ind["v_erp"][LAST], "unite": "pt",
         "score_z": us.Z["v_erp"][LAST], "mois": LAST.strftime("%Y-%m")}]
for k, lib, zg, u, mult in LIB:
    lv = mi.I[k].loc[:LAST].last_valid_index()
    rows.append({"indicateur": lib, "zone_geo": zg, "valeur": mi.I[k][lv] * mult, "unite": u, "score_z": mi.Z[k][lv], "mois": lv.strftime("%Y-%m")})
dump("indicateurs", rows)

# 4. backtest
rows = []
for v, r in us.res.iterrows():
    rows.append({"indice_nom": "S&P 500", "variante": v, "periode": f"1991-{us.end[:4]}", "corr_12m": r.get("c12"), "corr_2008_2025": r.get("c12_0825"),
                 "tcam_pct": r["tcam"] * 100, "perte_max_pct": r["perte_max"] * 100, "temps_investi_pct": r["investi"] * 100})
for nom, R in mi.RES.items():
    per = mi.CFG[nom]["start"][:4] + "-" + us.end[:4]
    for v, r in R.iterrows():
        rows.append({"indice_nom": nom, "variante": v, "periode": per, "corr_12m": r["corr_12m"], "corr_2008_2025": r["corr_2008_2025"],
                     "tcam_pct": r["tcam"] * 100, "perte_max_pct": r["perte_max"] * 100, "temps_investi_pct": r["investi"] * 100})
    r = R.iloc[0]
    rows.append({"indice_nom": nom, "variante": "Achat-conservation", "periode": per, "corr_12m": None, "corr_2008_2025": None,
                 "tcam_pct": r["tcam_bh"] * 100, "perte_max_pct": r["perte_max_bh"] * 100, "temps_investi_pct": 100.0})
dump("backtest", rows)

# 5. date de mise à jour et sources en échec
maj = os.path.join(HERE, "..", "data", "maj.json")
info = json.load(open(maj)) if os.path.exists(maj) else {"date": None, "erreurs": []}
json.dump({"rows": [{"mise_a_jour": info.get("date"), "dernier_mois": LAST.strftime("%Y-%m"),
                     "sources_en_echec": "; ".join(info.get("erreurs") or []) or "aucune"}], "meta": META},
          open(f"{OUT}/maj.json", "w"), ensure_ascii=False)

# 6. Synthèse « où en est le monde » + actualité (titres récents)
import re
act_f = os.path.join(HERE, "..", "data", "actualite.json")
ACT = json.load(open(act_f)).get("articles", []) if os.path.exists(act_f) else []
THEMES_IDX = {"S&P 500": ["wall_street", "fed", "monde"], "CAC 40": ["cac", "bce", "monde"], "MSCI World": ["monde", "wall_street", "fed", "bce"]}
SUJETS = [(r"\bFed\b|Réserve fédérale|Powell", "la Fed"), (r"\bBCE\b|Lagarde", "la BCE"),
          (r"inflation|prix à la consommation", "l'inflation"), (r"\btaux\b", "les taux d'intérêt"),
          (r"droits de douane|tarifs douaniers|guerre commerciale", "les droits de douane"),
          (r"pétrole|Brent|Opep", "le pétrole"), (r"emploi|chômage", "l'emploi"),
          (r"résultats|bénéfices|chiffre d'affaires", "les résultats des entreprises"),
          (r"\bIA\b|intelligence artificielle|Nvidia", "l'intelligence artificielle"), (r"Chine|Pékin|chinois", "la Chine"),
          (r"guerre|Ukraine|Russie|Israël|Iran|Moyen-Orient|géopoliti", "les tensions géopolitiques"),
          (r"élection|gouvernement|budget|shutdown|Trump", "la politique et les budgets"),
          (r"récession|croissance|PIB", "la croissance"), (r"dollar|euro\b|devise", "les devises")]
LIBP = {"Croissance": "la croissance", "Inflation et banques centrales": "l'inflation et les banques centrales",
        "Conditions financières": "les conditions financières", "Valorisation": "la valorisation",
        "Sentiment et tendance": "le sentiment et la tendance", "Géopolitique et incertitude": "la géopolitique et l'incertitude"}
MOISFR = ["janvier", "février", "mars", "avril", "mai", "juin", "juillet", "août", "septembre", "octobre", "novembre", "décembre"]
fr1 = lambda v: f"{v:.1f}".replace(".", ",")
nb = lambda v, d=2: f"{math.copysign(math.floor(abs(round(float(v), 4)) * 10**d + 0.5), v) / 10**d:+.{d}f}".replace(".", ",").replace("-", "−")
syn, act_rows = [], []
for nom, s in SER.items():
    D_ = s["D"].dropna(); v, v3 = D_[LAST], D_[PREV]; zone = zname(s["pct"][LAST])
    pil = [r for r in rows_piliers if r["indice_nom"] == nom]
    dans = [r for r in pil if r["dans_le_score"] == "oui" and r["score"] is not None and np.isfinite(r["score"])]
    fort, faible = max(dans, key=lambda r: r["score"]), min(dans, key=lambda r: r["score"])
    bouge = [r for r in dans if r["variation_3m"] is not None]
    dv = v - v3
    sens = f"en hausse de {fr1(dv)}" if dv > 0.5 else f"en baisse de {fr1(-dv)}" if dv < -0.5 else "quasi stable"
    pts = "" if abs(dv) <= 0.5 else (" point" if abs(dv) < 2 else " points")
    t = f"En {MOISFR[LAST.month - 1]} {LAST.year}, le contexte est {zone} pour le {nom} ({fr1(v)}/100, {sens}{pts} sur 3 mois). "
    t += f"Principal soutien : {LIBP[fort['pilier']]} ({nb(fort['score'])}). Principal frein : {LIBP[faible['pilier']]} ({nb(faible['score'])}). "
    if bouge:
        b = max(bouge, key=lambda r: abs(r["variation_3m"]))
        if abs(b["variation_3m"]) > 0.1:
            t += f"Ce qui a le plus bougé en 3 mois : {LIBP[b['pilier']]}, qui {"s'améliore" if b['variation_3m'] > 0 else 'se dégrade'} ({nb(b['variation_3m'])}). "
    valo = next((r for r in pil if r["pilier"] == "Valorisation" and r["score"] is not None and np.isfinite(r["score"])), None)
    if valo and valo["score"] <= -1: t += "La valorisation reste élevée : le marché paraît cher (garde-fou, hors score). "
    mes = sorted([a for a in ACT if a["theme"] in THEMES_IDX[nom]], key=lambda a: a["date"], reverse=True)
    vus = set(); mes = [a for a in mes if not (a["titre"] in vus or vus.add(a["titre"]))]
    compte = {}
    for a in mes:
        for rx, lib in SUJETS:
            if re.search(rx, a["titre"], re.I): compte[lib] = compte.get(lib, 0) + 1
    tri = sorted(compte.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])
    top = [k for k, n in tri if n >= 2][:3] or [k for k, n in tri][:2]
    if top:
        t += "Dans l'actualité de ces derniers jours, les marchés suivent surtout " + (", ".join(top[:-1]) + " et " + top[-1] if len(top) > 1 else top[0]) + "."
    elif not mes:
        t += "L'actualité récente n'a pas pu être récupérée."
    syn.append({"indice_nom": nom, "texte": t.strip()})
    for a in mes[:5]:
        act_rows.append({"indice_nom": nom, **{k: a[k] for k in ["titre", "source", "lien", "date"]}})
dump("synthese", syn)
dump("actualite", act_rows)

"""Backtest v3 de l'indice GAP sur le S&P 500 : vraies sources (FRED, multpl, Shiller, CBOE, EIA)."""
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, sys, os
import os
D = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "..", "data")
pd.set_option("display.width", 220)

def ms(s):
    s.index = pd.to_datetime(s.index).to_period("M").to_timestamp(); return s.groupby(level=0).last()

_sp = pd.read_csv(f"{D}/s-and-p-500.csv", parse_dates=["Date"])
FIN = _sp.loc[_sp["SP500"] > 0, "Date"].max().to_period("M").to_timestamp()      # dernier mois avec un cours du S&P 500
idx = pd.date_range("1984-01-01", FIN, freq="MS")
# --- S&P 500 (Shiller jusqu'à 06/2023, prolongé par multpl) ---
sp = pd.read_csv(f"{D}/s-and-p-500.csv", parse_dates=["Date"]).set_index("Date")
price = ms(sp["SP500"]).reindex(idx)
earn = ms(sp["Earnings"].replace(0, np.nan)).reindex(idx)
div = ms(sp["Dividend"].replace(0, np.nan)).reindex(idx)
mp = pd.read_csv(f"{D}/multpl.csv").set_index("mois"); mp.index = pd.to_datetime(mp.index + "-01")
k = earn["2023-06-01"] / mp.loc["2023-06-01", "earnings_ttm"]           # raccord des deux sources
earn = earn.fillna(mp["earnings_ttm"].reindex(idx) * k)
dy = (div / price)
dy = dy.fillna(mp["div_yield"].reindex(idx) / 100).ffill()
# --- FRED ---
f = pd.read_csv(f"{D}/fred_us.csv").set_index("mois"); f.index = pd.to_datetime(f.index + "-01"); f = f.reindex(idx)
vix = ms(pd.read_csv(f"{D}/finance-vix.csv", parse_dates=["DATE"]).set_index("DATE")["CLOSE"].resample("ME").mean()).reindex(idx)
brent = ms(pd.read_csv(f"{D}/oil-prices.csv", parse_dates=["Date"]).set_index("Date")["Price"]).reindex(idx)
y10 = ms(pd.read_csv(f"{D}/bond-yields-us-10y.csv", parse_dates=["Date"]).set_index("Date")["Rate"]).reindex(idx)

ret = price.pct_change() + dy / 12
fwd12 = (1 + ret).rolling(12).apply(np.prod, raw=True).shift(-12) - 1
fwd3 = (1 + ret).rolling(3).apply(np.prod, raw=True).shift(-3) - 1
cash = f["tbill3m"].shift(1) / 100 / 12

# --- indicateurs (signe + = favorable ; décalage = délai de publication) ---
L = lambda s, n: s.shift(n)
ind = pd.DataFrame(index=idx)
ind["g_cli"] = L(f["cli"].diff(3), 1)
ind["g_chom"] = -L(f["chomage"].ffill().diff(6), 1)
ind["i_pce"] = -L((f["pce_core_ga"] - 2).abs(), 1)
ind["i_ff_v1"] = -L(f["fedfunds"].diff(6), 0)                          # v1 : baisse des taux = favorable
ind["i_ff_v2"] = -L(f["fedfunds"].diff(6).clip(lower=0), 0)             # v2 : seule une hausse pénalise
ind["f_credit"] = -L(f["baa10y"], 0)
ind["f_usd"] = -L(np.log(f["dollar"]).diff(6), 0)
ind["f_oil"] = -L(np.log(brent).diff(6), 0)
ind["v_erp"] = L(earn / price * 100 - y10, 3)
ind["s_vix"] = -vix
ind["s_mom"] = price.shift(1) / price.shift(12) - 1
ind["u_epu"] = -L(f["epu"], 0)

def z(s, win=120, minp=60):
    m = s.rolling(win, min_periods=minp).mean(); sd = s.rolling(win, min_periods=minp).std()
    return ((s - m) / sd).clip(-2, 2)
Z = ind.apply(z)
P = pd.DataFrame(index=idx)
P["croissance"] = Z[["g_cli", "g_chom"]].mean(axis=1)
P["infl_v1"] = Z[["i_pce", "i_ff_v1"]].mean(axis=1)
P["infl_v2"] = Z[["i_pce", "i_ff_v2"]].mean(axis=1)
P["financier"] = Z[["f_credit", "f_usd", "f_oil"]].mean(axis=1)
P["valo"] = Z["v_erp"]
P["sentiment"] = Z[["s_vix", "s_mom"]].mean(axis=1)
P["incertitude"] = Z["u_epu"]

def wavg(W):
    num = sum(P[c].fillna(0) * w for c, w in W.items()); den = sum(P[c].notna() * w for c, w in W.items())
    return 50 + 25 * num / den.replace(0, np.nan)
W1 = {"croissance": 25, "infl_v1": 15, "financier": 20, "valo": 15, "sentiment": 15, "incertitude": 10}
W2 = {"croissance": 25, "infl_v2": 15, "financier": 20, "sentiment": 15, "incertitude": 10}
idx_v1 = wavg(W1)
idx_v2b = wavg(W2)
trend = z(idx_v2b.diff(3))
idx_v2c = 0.5 * idx_v2b + 0.5 * (50 + 25 * trend)

def pct_rank(s, win=120, minp=60):
    return s.rolling(win, min_periods=minp).apply(lambda a: (a[:-1] < a[-1]).mean() if np.isfinite(a[-1]) else np.nan, raw=True)

start = "1991-01-01"
endr = FIN.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
end = (FIN - pd.DateOffset(months=12)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
def zones_abs(s): return pd.cut(s, [-1, 35, 65, 101], labels=["prudence", "neutre", "favorable"])
def zones_pct(s, lo=.2, hi=.8): return pd.cut(pct_rank(s), [-.01, lo, hi, 1.01], labels=["prudence", "neutre", "favorable"])

def strat(zone):
    inv = (zone != "prudence").astype(float).shift(1)
    r = (inv * ret + (1 - inv) * cash)[start:endr].dropna(); eq = (1 + r).cumprod()
    return eq.iloc[-1] ** (12 / len(r)) - 1, (eq / eq.cummax() - 1).min(), inv[start:endr].mean()

def report(name, s, zone):
    d = pd.DataFrame({"s": s, "f12": fwd12, "f3": fwd3, "zone": zone})[start:end].dropna(subset=["s"])
    c = lambda a, b, col: d.loc[a:b, ["s", col]].dropna().corr().iloc[0, 1]
    cagr, dd, inv = strat(zone)
    zs = d.groupby("zone", observed=False)["f12"].agg(["mean", "count"]); zs["part"] = zs["count"] / zs["count"].sum()
    return dict(variante=name, c12=c(start, end, "f12"), c12_9107=c("1991", "2007", "f12"), c12_0825=c("2008", end, "f12"),
                c3=c(start, end, "f3"), tcam=cagr, perte_max=dd, investi=inv,
                **{f"{q}_f12": zs.loc[q, "mean"] for q in zs.index}, **{f"{q}_part": zs.loc[q, "part"] for q in zs.index})

rows = [report("A. Méthode v1 (seuils 35/65)", idx_v1, zones_abs(idx_v1)),
        report("B. v1 + seuils percentiles 20/80", idx_v1, zones_pct(idx_v1)),
        report("C. B + pilier 2 revu + valo hors score", idx_v2b, zones_pct(idx_v2b)),
        report("D. C + tendance du score (3 mois)", idx_v2c, zones_pct(idx_v2c))]
r = ret[start:endr].dropna(); eq = (1 + r).cumprod()
rows.append(dict(variante="Achat-conservation", tcam=eq.iloc[-1] ** (12 / len(r)) - 1, perte_max=(eq / eq.cummax() - 1).min(), investi=1.0))
res = pd.DataFrame(rows).set_index("variante")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(res.round(3).T.to_string())
    print("\nCorrélation avec le rendement à 12 mois (1991-2025):")
    allp = pd.concat([P, Z, trend.rename("tendance_score")], axis=1)[start:end]
    print(allp.corrwith(fwd12[start:end]).round(2).to_string())
    print("\nRobustesse D:")
    for h in [1, 3, 6]:
        for lo, hi in [(.15, .85), (.2, .8), (.25, .75)]:
            s = 0.5 * idx_v2b + 0.5 * (50 + 25 * z(idx_v2b.diff(h)))
            cagr, dd, inv = strat(zones_pct(s, lo, hi))

"""Backtest v4 : indice GAP pour le CAC 40 et le MSCI World (pondération des zones US / zone euro / Chine)."""
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import backtest_v3 as us                       # S&P 500 et données US (FRED, VIX, Brent, momentum...)
D = us.D
idx = us.idx
z, pct_rank = us.z, us.pct_rank

eu = pd.read_csv(f"{D}/fred_eu_cn.csv").set_index("mois"); eu.index = pd.to_datetime(eu.index + "-01"); eu = eu.reindex(idx)
cac = pd.read_csv(f"{D}/cac40.csv").set_index("mois"); cac.index = pd.to_datetime(cac.index + "-01")
cac = cac["cac40"].reindex(idx)
ms = pd.read_csv(f"{D}/msci_world.csv").set_index("mois"); ms.index = pd.to_datetime(ms.index + "-01"); ms = ms.reindex(idx)

# rendements totaux mensuels
ret_cac = cac.pct_change(fill_method=None) + 0.03 / 12                       # CAC 40 prix + dividende ~3 %/an (approximation)
ret_msci = ms["msci_gr"].pct_change(fill_method=None)                       # MSCI World dividendes réinvestis (depuis 2001)
ret_msci = ret_msci.fillna(ms["msci_prix"].pct_change(fill_method=None) + 0.02 / 12)
cash_eur = (eu["taux_bce"].shift(1) / 100 / 12).fillna(us.cash)
cash_usd = us.cash

def fwd(ret, n): return (1 + ret).rolling(n).apply(np.prod, raw=True).shift(-n) - 1

# --- indicateurs par zone (+ = favorable) ---
I = pd.DataFrame(index=idx)
# Croissance
I["g_us_cli"], I["g_us_chom"] = us.ind["g_cli"], us.ind["g_chom"]
I["g_ez_cli"] = ((eu["cli_de"] + eu["cli_fr"]) / 2).diff(3).shift(1)
I["g_ez_chom"] = -((eu["chom_fr"].ffill() + eu["chom_de"].ffill()) / 2).diff(6).shift(1)
I["g_cn_cli"] = eu["cli_cn"].diff(3).shift(1)
# Inflation / banques centrales
I["i_us_pce"], I["i_us_taux"] = us.ind["i_pce"], us.ind["i_ff_v2"]
I["i_ez_hicp"] = -(eu["hicp_ga"] - 2).abs().shift(1)
I["i_ez_taux"] = -eu["taux_bce"].diff(6).clip(lower=0)
# Conditions financières
I["f_credit"], I["f_oil"], I["f_usd"] = us.ind["f_credit"], us.ind["f_oil"], us.ind["f_usd"]
I["f_eur_faible"] = -np.log(eu["eurusd"]).diff(6)                            # euro qui baisse = favorable au CAC 40
# Sentiment
I["s_vix"] = us.ind["s_vix"]
I["s_mom_cac"] = cac.shift(1) / cac.shift(12) - 1
I["s_mom_msci"] = ms["msci_prix"].shift(1) / ms["msci_prix"].shift(12) - 1
# Incertitude
I["u_us_epu"] = us.ind["u_epu"]
I["u_ez_epu"] = -eu["epu_eu"]
Z = I.apply(z)

def zone_mix(parts, w):
    """parts = {zone: série de score}, w = {zone: poids} ; renormalise si une zone manque."""
    num = sum(parts[k].fillna(0) * w[k] for k in parts); den = sum(parts[k].notna() * w[k] for k in parts)
    return num / den.replace(0, np.nan)

def piliers(w, dollar_col, mom_col):
    P = pd.DataFrame(index=idx)
    P["croissance"] = zone_mix({"us": Z[["g_us_cli", "g_us_chom"]].mean(axis=1), "ez": Z[["g_ez_cli", "g_ez_chom"]].mean(axis=1),
                                "cn": Z["g_cn_cli"]}, w)
    P["infl"] = zone_mix({"us": Z[["i_us_pce", "i_us_taux"]].mean(axis=1), "ez": Z[["i_ez_hicp", "i_ez_taux"]].mean(axis=1)}, w)
    P["financier"] = Z[["f_credit", "f_oil", dollar_col]].mean(axis=1)
    P["sentiment"] = Z[["s_vix", mom_col]].mean(axis=1)
    P["incertitude"] = zone_mix({"us": Z["u_us_epu"], "ez": Z["u_ez_epu"]}, w)
    return P

W = {"croissance": 25, "infl": 15, "financier": 20, "sentiment": 15, "incertitude": 10}   # valorisation : non disponible
def indice(P):
    num = sum(P[c].fillna(0) * w for c, w in W.items()); den = sum(P[c].notna() * w for c, w in W.items())
    lvl = 50 + 25 * num / den.replace(0, np.nan)
    return lvl, 0.5 * lvl + 0.5 * (50 + 25 * z(lvl.diff(3)))

CFG = {
    "CAC 40": dict(w={"us": .20, "ez": .65, "cn": .15}, dollar="f_eur_faible", mom="s_mom_cac", ret=ret_cac, cash=cash_eur,
                   start="1996-01-01", prix=cac),
    "MSCI World": dict(w={"us": .70, "ez": .20, "cn": .10}, dollar="f_usd", mom="s_mom_msci", ret=ret_msci, cash=cash_usd,
                       start="1998-01-01", prix=ms["msci_prix"]),
}
end, endr = us.end, us.endr

def evaluate(name, s, zone, ret, cash, start):
    f12 = fwd(ret, 12); f3 = fwd(ret, 3)
    d = pd.DataFrame({"s": s, "f12": f12, "f3": f3})[start:end].dropna()
    c = lambda a, b, col: d.loc[a:b, ["s", col]].corr().iloc[0, 1]
    inv = (zone != "prudence").astype(float).shift(1)
    r = (inv * ret + (1 - inv) * cash)[start:endr].dropna(); eq = (1 + r).cumprod()
    rb = ret[start:endr].dropna(); eb = (1 + rb).cumprod()
    return dict(variante=name, corr_12m=c(start, end, "f12"), corr_avant_2008=c(start, "2007-12-01", "f12"),
                corr_2008_2025=c("2008-01-01", end, "f12"), corr_3m=c(start, end, "f3"),
                tcam=eq.iloc[-1] ** (12 / len(r)) - 1, perte_max=(eq / eq.cummax() - 1).min(), investi=inv[start:endr].mean(),
                tcam_bh=eb.iloc[-1] ** (12 / len(rb)) - 1, perte_max_bh=(eb / eb.cummax() - 1).min())

RES, OUT = {}, {}
for nom, c in CFG.items():
    P = piliers(c["w"], c["dollar"], c["mom"])
    lvl, tr = indice(P)
    zc = pd.cut(pct_rank(lvl), [-.01, .2, .8, 1.01], labels=["prudence", "neutre", "favorable"])
    zd = pd.cut(pct_rank(tr), [-.01, .2, .8, 1.01], labels=["prudence", "neutre", "favorable"])
    RES[nom] = pd.DataFrame([evaluate("C. Niveau, seuils percentiles", lvl, zc, c["ret"], c["cash"], c["start"]),
                             evaluate("D. C + tendance du score", tr, zd, c["ret"], c["cash"], c["start"])]).set_index("variante")
    OUT[nom] = dict(P=P, lvl=lvl, D=tr, pct=pct_rank(tr), zone=zd, prix=c["prix"], ret=c["ret"])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    pd.set_option("display.width", 220)
    for nom in CFG:
        print(f"\n=== {nom} ({CFG[nom]['start'][:4]}-2025) ===")
        print(RES[nom].round(3).T.to_string())
        P, tr = OUT[nom]["P"], OUT[nom]["D"]
        f12 = fwd(CFG[nom]["ret"], 12)
        print("corr piliers:", P[CFG[nom]["start"]:end].corrwith(f12[CFG[nom]["start"]:end]).round(2).to_dict())
        last = us.FIN
        print("Dernière:", "D=%.1f pct=%.2f zone=%s" % (tr[last], OUT[nom]["pct"][last], OUT[nom]["zone"][last]), P.loc[last].round(2).to_dict())
